content.text: The text combines scientific articles, travel writing, adventure fiction, and a North-West Mounted Police narrative. It describes the maidenhair tree and a museum collection of American woods, then follows four boys flying from Quito after encounters with savages, thieves, haunted temples, jaguars, and conspirators pursuing embezzler Milo Redfern. Jimmie and Carl return to their camp, enter a ruined temple, are trapped with jaguars, escape through underground passages, and reunite with Sam. Havens, Ben, Glenn, and Sam later reach the temple and capture Redfern in a fortress. A separate story follows Officer Cameron and Jerry into a canyon cave, where an Indian council plots rebellion; Cameron later returns to the camp and arrests Eagle Feather. Cameron then reaches the Big Horn Ranch, while doctors and nurses care for an injured Indian boy.
